isPinned.description: Whether this row is the post its author pinned to the profile. Profile reads include the pinned post. Flat rows only. Rows stay in date order.

isRetweet.title: Is retweet
isRetweet.description: Whether this row is a retweet. retweetedTweet holds the original post in full.

quotedTweetId.title: Quoted Tweet ID
quotedTweetId.description: Quoted tweet ID, even when its full object is unavailable.

isReply.title: Is reply
isReply.description: Whether this tweet is a reply to another tweet.

inReplyToId.title: In reply to Tweet ID
inReplyToId.description: ID of the tweet this post replies to. Present when isReply is true.

inReplyToUserId.title: In reply to user ID
inReplyToUserId.description: User ID of the author this post replies to. Present when isReply is true.

inReplyToUsername.title: In reply to username
inReplyToUsername.description: Username of the author this post replies to. Present when isReply is true.

conversationId.title: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: ID of the conversation thread this tweet belongs to.

conversationControl.title: Conversation control
conversationControl.description: Public reply policy and conversation owner.

allowedCountryCodes.description: Country codes of the regions whose accounts may reply, under the country_of_origin mode.

inviteViaMention.description: Whether the reply policy allows mentioned accounts to join the conversation.

mode.description: Reply policy from X's newer field in lowercase snake_case, such as my_network or premium.

policy.description: Public reply policy in lowercase snake_case, such as verified_followers. Missing policy does not imply unrestricted replies.

liveEventContext.title: Live event
liveEventContext.description: The live event the post belongs to, such as an election.

sportsContext.title: Sports context
sportsContext.description: Sports game context attached to the post, when available.

gameId.description: X identifier for the sports game, stored as a string.

league.description: League name or identifier reported by X.

title.description: Display title for the sports game.

url.description: Public link associated with the sports game.

state.description: Game state reported by X. Values depend on the sport and source.

statusText.description: Human-readable game status reported by X.

scheduledAtMs.description: Scheduled Unix time in milliseconds, preserving the source representation.

teamId.description: X team identifier as a string.

color.description: Team display color as supplied by X.

isActive.description: Whether X marks this competitor as active in the game.

isWinner.description: Whether X marks this competitor as the winner. Missing values do not establish a loss.

name.description: Full team or competitor display name.

score.description: Score text supplied by X. Kept as text for sport-specific formats.

darkLogoUrl.description: Team logo image URL for dark backgrounds.

competitors.description: Teams or competitors with available scores and display metadata.

reactionContext.title: Reaction context
reactionContext.description: Public post and user referenced by this reaction.

reactedToPostId.description: ID of the post referenced by this reaction, as a decimal string.

reactedToUser.description: Public profile referenced by the reaction, when X supplies it.

subscriberBadge.title: Subscriber badge
subscriberBadge.description: Subscriber badge X shows on a reply. The reply's author subscribes to the creator who started the conversation.

creatorId.description: Account ID of the creator the author subscribes to, as a decimal string.

limitedActions.title: Limited actions
limitedActions.description: Public interaction restrictions and user-facing prompts.

action.description: Interaction restricted by X, such as replying or reposting.

headline.description: Main restriction message displayed by X.

subtext.description: Additional explanation displayed below the restriction headline.

prompt.description: Public explanation or call to action associated with the restriction.

source.title: Source
source.description: Client application used to post the tweet. X sends it for some posts only.

displayTextRange.title: Display text range
displayTextRange.description: Visible text range when X provides display range metadata.

textHighlights.title: Text highlights
textHighlights.description: Where the text matches the search, on each row a search read. Offsets count code points of the text. Empty when X marks nothing in the post. Highlights cover a post's first 280 characters only.

startIndex.title: Start index
startIndex.description: Code point offset of the first matched character.

endIndex.title: End index
endIndex.description: Code point offset just after the last matched character.

cashtagAttachments.title: Cashtag charts
cashtagAttachments.description: Price charts the author attached, 1 per cashtag, with each window in ISO 8601.

contentDisclosure.title: Content disclosure
contentDisclosure.description: Disclosure metadata such as paid partnership or AI disclosure when X provides it.

grokShareAttachment.title: Grok share attachment
grokShareAttachment.description: Public Grok share content, media, post IDs, and web links.

grokTranslatedPost.title: Grok translation
grokTranslatedPost.description: Grok's translation of the post, as X shows it.

jetfuelAttachment.title: Interactive attachment
jetfuelAttachment.description: Public interactive attachment metadata when X provides it.

isLimitedReply.title: Is limited reply
isLimitedReply.description: Whether this tweet has limited replies.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: Author-published point, with longitude before latitude.

geo.title: Geo
geo.description: Author-published point, with latitude before longitude.

postCta.title: Post call to action
postCta.description: Public call-to-action text, styling, destinations, and entity references.

unmentionedUserIds.title: Unmentioned user IDs
unmentionedUserIds.description: User IDs that left this conversation.

exclusiveContent.title: Exclusive content
exclusiveContent.description: Creator whose subscription unlocks a subscriber-only post. Omitted on public posts.

noteTweet.title: Note Tweet
noteTweet.description: Includes long-form text, entities, formatting, and inline media positions.

paidPartnership.title: Paid partnership
paidPartnership.description: Optional paid partnership disclosure metadata when available.

aiDisclosure.title: AI disclosure
aiDisclosure.description: Optional AI disclosure metadata when available.

possiblySensitive.title: Possibly sensitive
possiblySensitive.description: Whether X marks the tweet as possibly sensitive.

communityNote.title: Community note
communityNote.description: Community Note metadata when X provides it.

communityId.title: Community ID
communityId.description: Community ID when the tweet belongs to a community.

communityName.title: Community name
communityName.description: Community name when X sends it with a community tweet.

isTranslatable.title: Is translatable
isTranslatable.description: Whether X marks the tweet as translatable.

interstitial.title: Covering notice
interstitial.description: The notice x.com covers the tweet with until someone opens it, such as X's public interest notice.

displayType.description: How x.com shows the notice. NonCompliant marks a tweet that broke X's rules.

text.description: Notice text, direction & links by character range.

softIntervention.title: Reach label
softIntervention.description: The label X shows under a tweet whose reach it limits.

displayType.description: The label kind. Fosnr marks a tweet X keeps up but shows to fewer people.

engagementNudge.description: Whether X prompts people before they engage with the tweet.

text.description: Label text, direction & links by character range.

url.description: The page that explains the label.

quotedTweetUnavailable.title: Quoted tweet unavailable
quotedTweetUnavailable.description: Why X shows no quoted tweet, such as Suspended or Protected. Omitted when X names no reason.

previousCounts.title: Previous counts
previousCounts.description: Previous engagement counts when X provides edit history.

scopes.title: Public scopes
scopes.description: Public scope metadata without viewer-specific state.

tombstone.title: Visibility notice
tombstone.description: Public visibility notice attached to an available tweet.

text.description: Human-readable visibility notice supplied by X.

rtl.description: Whether X marks the notice text as right-to-left.

fromIndex.description: Start offset supplied by X for the referenced notice text.

toIndex.description: End offset supplied by X for the referenced notice text.

url.description: Destination URL for the notice reference.

ref.description: Reference associated with the notice text range.

entities.description: Links or other references embedded in the visibility notice.

text.description: Visibility notice text, direction, and linked entities when available.

viewState.title: View state
viewState.description: Tweet view-state metadata when X provides it.

hasCommunityNotes.title: Has Community Notes
hasCommunityNotes.description: Whether X holds Community Notes on the tweet, shown or not. Rich output only.

quotedTweetPermalink.title: Quoted Tweet link
quotedTweetPermalink.description: The quoted tweet's url, expandedUrl & displayUrl. It stays when X withholds the quoted tweet. Rich output only.

unavailableAuthorId.title: Unavailable author ID
unavailableAuthorId.description: The author's user ID when X withholds the author's profile. Rich output only.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Extracted public text entities, video timestamps, and market metadata.

quoted_tweet.title: Quoted Tweet
quoted_tweet.description: The quoted tweet object, present when isQuoteStatus is true. Same shape as a top-level tweet.

url.title: URL
url.description: Direct link to the quoted tweet.

retweeted_tweet.title: Retweeted Tweet
retweeted_tweet.description: The original tweet of a retweet, present when type is retweet. Same shape as a top-level tweet.

url.title: URL
url.description: Direct link to the original tweet.

article.title: Article
article.description: Structured X article data in article mode. Includes bodyText, contents, coverImageUrl, previewText, createdAt, and metrics when available.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: X's translation of the Tweet in translation mode. Includes language, sourceLanguage, text & entities with the links, mentions & tags of the translated text.

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: The HTML that embeds the Tweet on a website in embed mode. Includes url, authorName, authorUrl, html & width.

created_at.title: Created at (snake_case)
created_at.description: Snake-case tweet creation timestamp for expanded output.

retweet_count.title: Retweets (snake_case)
retweet_count.description: Snake-case retweet count for expanded output.

reply_count.title: Replies (snake_case)
reply_count.description: Snake-case reply count for expanded output.

like_count.title: Likes (snake_case)
like_count.description: Snake-case like count for expanded output.

quote_count.title: Quotes (snake_case)
quote_count.description: Snake-case quote count for expanded output.

view_count.title: Views (snake_case)
view_count.description: Snake-case view count for expanded output.

bookmark_count.title: Bookmarks (snake_case)
bookmark_count.description: Snake-case bookmark count for expanded output.

unknown_counts.title: Unknown counts (snake_case)
unknown_counts.description: The counts X did not send for this post, named like the count fields. Each one reads 0, so treat it as unknown, not as a real 0. Left out when X sent every count.

tweet_url.title: Tweet URL (snake_case)
tweet_url.description: Snake-case tweet URL for flat expanded output.

media_urls.title: Media URLs (snake_case)
media_urls.description: Snake-case media URLs for flat expanded output.

status.title: Status
status.description: Diagnostic status for incomplete replies, no input, invalid input, zero output, aborts, or unexpected errors.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation. Present only on diagnostic rows.
message.example: No tweets matched the requested query.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Present only on diagnostic rows.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Actor name. Present only on diagnostic rows.

actorVersion.title: Actor version
actorVersion.description: Apify build number of the run. Present only on diagnostic rows.

resultType.title: Result type
resultType.description: Row type, which is tweet, user, article, translation, embed, or diagnostic. Some stable tweet rows may omit this field.

replyCoverage.title: Reply coverage
replyCoverage.description: Direct reply coverage details. Present on replies-incomplete diagnostic rows when your limit allows. Real reply rows always come first.

complete.description: Whether the run reached its direct reply coverage target. It does not prove X has no more replies.

replyTreeComplete.description: All reported child counts match collected replies, including nested branches. Absent when counts are unknown or do not match. Source errors remain separate.

reply_tree_complete.description: Snake-case alias of replyTreeComplete. All reported child counts match collected replies. Absent when counts are unknown or do not match.

replyScopeComplete.description: All reported child counts within the requested scope & depth match. Deeper replies may remain. Source errors remain separate.

reply_scope_complete.description: Snake-case alias of replyScopeComplete. Confirms replies within the requested scope & depth. Deeper replies may remain.

reportedReplyCount.description: Reply count reported by X for the source post. It may include unavailable replies.

reported_reply_count.description: Snake-case alias of reportedReplyCount. Reply count reported by X for the source post. It may include unavailable replies.

targetDirectReplies.description: Direct reply count the Actor aims for, based on the reported count.

target_direct_replies.description: Snake-case alias of targetDirectReplies. Direct reply count the Actor aims for, based on the reported count.

uniqueDirectReplies.description: Unique direct replies collected before final Actor filtering and result limits.

unique_direct_replies.description: Snake-case alias of uniqueDirectReplies. Unique direct replies collected before final Actor filtering and result limits.

coveragePercentage.description: Collected direct replies divided by the reported count, multiplied by 100. Rounded to 2 decimals. It is 100 when the reported count is 0. It does not prove X has no more replies.

coverage_percentage.description: Snake-case alias of coveragePercentage. Collected direct replies divided by the reported count, multiplied by 100. Rounded to 2 decimals. It is 100 when the reported count is 0. It does not prove X has no more replies.

nestedReplyCount.description: Unique nested replies collected, excluding direct replies to the source post.

nested_reply_count.description: Snake-case alias of nestedReplyCount. Unique nested replies collected, excluding direct replies to the source post.

pagesAttempted.description: Collection steps the Actor tried, including failed ones. Share it with support when coverage looks low.

pages_attempted.description: Snake-case alias of pagesAttempted. Collection steps the Actor tried, including failed ones. Share it with support when coverage looks low.

strategiesAttempted.description: Progress entries with new reply counts and stop reasons. Share them with support when coverage looks low.

strategies_attempted.description: Snake-case alias of strategiesAttempted. Progress entries with new reply counts and stop reasons. Share them with support when coverage looks low.

duplicateCount.description: Duplicate reply occurrences detected during collection, before result billing.

duplicate_count.description: Snake-case alias of duplicateCount. Duplicate reply occurrences detected during collection, before result billing.

cursorFailures.description: Times collection could not continue from where it stopped.

cursor_failures.description: Snake-case alias of cursorFailures. Times collection could not continue from where it stopped.

repeatedCursorCount.description: Pages that added no new replies.

repeated_cursor_count.description: Snake-case alias of repeatedCursorCount. Pages that added no new replies.

emptyFalseProgressPages.description: Steps that brought no new eligible replies.

empty_false_progress_pages.description: Snake-case alias of emptyFalseProgressPages. Steps that brought no new eligible replies.

malformedCount.description: Reply occurrences the Actor rejected because of malformed data or identifiers.

malformed_count.description: Snake-case alias of malformedCount. Reply occurrences the Actor rejected because of malformed data or identifiers.

unrelatedCount.description: Post occurrences rejected because they did not belong to the requested conversation.

unrelated_count.description: Snake-case alias of unrelatedCount. Post occurrences rejected because they did not belong to the requested conversation.

missingResponseModulesOrFields.description: Names of expected data X left out. Share them with support.

missing_response_modules_or_fields.description: Snake-case alias of missingResponseModulesOrFields. Names of expected data X left out. Share them with support.

recommendedFallback.description: Suggested next step when coverage is incomplete. A new run may find more replies.

recommended_fallback.description: Snake-case alias of recommendedFallback. Suggested next step when coverage is incomplete. A new run may find more replies.

responseTruncated.description: Whether a size limit left out some collected replies. Your result limits may reduce output separately.

response_truncated.description: Snake-case alias of responseTruncated. Whether a size limit left out some collected replies. Your result limits may reduce output separately.

sourcesEnded.description: Whether X had no more replies to return. It is false on these rows, since a finished read adds no row.

sources_ended.description: Snake-case alias of sourcesEnded. Whether X had no more replies to return. It is false on these rows, since a finished read adds no row.

richness.description: Counts of collected replies containing each metadata category, plus totalReplies. These are counts, not percentages or delivered-row charges.

sourceTweetId.title: Source Tweet ID
sourceTweetId.description: Tweet ID that produced this row in article, translation, embed or engagement modes.

sourceTarget.title: Source target
sourceTarget.description: Profile, list, or tweet target that produced this row, or the query of mode Top tweets.

engagementMode.title: Engagement mode
engagementMode.description: Explicit mode that produced this engagement row.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: The search term that produced this tweet. Present only when includeSearchTerms is true.

result_type.title: Result type (snake_case)
result_type.description: Snake-case result type for expanded output.

reply_coverage.title: Reply coverage (snake_case)
reply_coverage.description: Snake-case direct-reply coverage diagnostic for expanded output.

actor_version.title: Actor version (snake_case)
actor_version.description: Snake-case Actor version for expanded diagnostic output.

source_tweet_id.title: Source Tweet ID (snake_case)
source_tweet_id.description: Snake-case source tweet identifier for expanded output.

source_target.title: Source target (snake_case)
source_target.description: Snake-case source target for expanded output.

engagement_mode.title: Engagement mode (snake_case)
engagement_mode.description: Snake-case engagement mode for expanded output.

search_term.title: Search term (snake_case)
search_term.description: Snake-case search term for expanded output.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional safe source object for raw output variants.

totalEngagement.title: Total Engagement
totalEngagement.description: likeCount + replyCount + retweetCount + quoteCount of the post. A missing count adds 0. Null for a row with none of those counts. It arrives when Fields to keep or Rename fields names it.

engagementRate.title: Engagement Rate
engagementRate.description: totalEngagement × 100 ÷ the author's followers, to 4 decimals. Null when the follower count is missing or 0. It arrives when Fields to keep or Rename fields names it.

engagementPerView.title: Engagement Per View
engagementPerView.description: totalEngagement × 100 ÷ viewCount, to 4 decimals. Null when the view count is missing or 0. It arrives when Fields to keep or Rename fields names it.

fields.description: Output fields depend on the selected mode, output preset, and source availability. Missing fields are unknown or inapplicable, not automatically 0 or false. Explicit null values indicate unavailable data where supported. Post and Tweet refer to the same X content. Repost is the current term for Retweet. Existing field names remain compatible.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Case-invariant tweet fields plus canonical diagnostics.

camelCase.title: camelCase fields
camelCase.description: Shows camelCase columns for runs using fieldStyle camelCase. Does not rename stored or exported data.

snakeCase.title: snake_case fields
snakeCase.description: Shows snake_case columns for runs using fieldStyle snake_case. Does not rename stored or exported data.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Legacy and camelCase diagnostic fields for incomplete, empty, aborted, and errored runs. Use snake_case Fields for snake_case output. The diagnostics output holds every diagnostic.

translationsEmbeds.title: Translations & embeds
translationsEmbeds.description: Rows of the translation & embed modes, 1 for each Tweet.

keyValueStore.title: X Tweet Scraper key-value store
keyValueStore.description: Actionable diagnostics and the Tweet run report.

reports.title: Run report
reports.description: Run-level summary with mode, totals, pricing tier, outcome, and anomalies. A run writes it when it hits a problem, is large or has Always save run records on.

version.title: Actor version
version.description: Apify build number of the run.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Resolved mode, limits, and output settings.

outputPreset.title: Output preset
outputPreset.description: Resolved nested or flat row layout.

results.title: Results
results.description: Delivered rows, failures, completion reason, and estimated charge.

totalPushed.title: Total pushed
totalPushed.description: All delivered data rows, without diagnostics.

failedSubtargets.title: Failed subtargets
failedSubtargets.description: Parts of the run that ended with an error. The rest of the run still delivers its rows.

estimatedChargeUsd.title: Estimated row charge
estimatedChargeUsd.description: What this run's delivered rows cost, in US dollars. Diagnostics are free.

filtering.title: Filtering counts
filtering.description: Rows the filters removed. A repeated row can count more than once. You never pay for removed rows.

serverFilteredRows.title: Rows removed early
serverFilteredRows.description: Rows your filters removed before the Actor received them. Unreported counts add nothing.

actorFilteredRows.title: Actor-filtered rows
actorFilteredRows.description: Returned rows rejected by Actor filters before deduplication and billing.

pagesWithUnknownServerFiltering.title: Unreported filter counts
pagesWithUnknownServerFiltering.description: Collection steps that reported no early filter count. Their removed rows are unknown.

runtimeMaxRssBytes.title: Runtime peak memory
runtimeMaxRssBytes.description: Peak Actor process memory in bytes.

anomalyCounts.title: Anomaly counts
anomalyCounts.description: Sanitized anomaly counters grouped by type.
